svg.title: Uniform finite cloud and its acoustic form factor
svg.desc: A finite sphere of radius Rc contains Nb equal bubble sources with number density nb. The observer lies outside at r. Wave number k and frequency omega compare wave transit to source time.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Finite size changes the coherent source amplitude
